Retain the proved exact signed 18-bit reduction with 32-bit sign extension and unchanged cycle contract. Preserve candidate 1 physical/postprocess/total costs 3420.889992701006/4.1100429370999336e-7/3420.8899931120104 seconds and candidate 2 costs 4120.200828565983/3.839959390461445e-7/4120.200828949979 seconds, with elapsed_search_seconds=3585.433121506998 and 7873.277321411995 respectively. These EDA-inclusive elapsed fields do not establish consumption of the shared 1200-second agent budget; EDA wait is separate. Submit only this remaining evaluation.
